DataTester supports the creation of customer group experiments, which are suitable for marketing scenarios that compare the needs of different circled groups to help business operators select more matching groups in different scenarios and optimize marketing reach and conversion efficiency. This article introduces the operation process and key points of customer group experiment.

<span id="c09d98a0"></span>
# Principle of customer group experiment diversion

The shunt process of the customer group experiment is similar to the general AB test shunt process, and the judgment of the customer group experiment is added on the basis of the general process, and the customer group ID is returned after receiving the shunt request. The summary process and the clustering specific points of the customer group experiment are as follows. Please refer to the general clustering process for details [Diversion principle: Diversion traffic chart](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Basic-Concept#e614b9ce).

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

The main differences between the customer group experiment and the general diversion process are:


* Rule filtering: When the experimental layer hits the experiment, it is necessary to determine whether the experiment is a customer group experiment. If so, it is filtered by a separate customer group rule. After hitting, it is necessary to determine whether to randomly enter a customer group according to hash bucketing, and bring the customer group ID.

* Report the exposure event: If the hit is a customer group experiment, when reporting the exposure event, bring the custom attribute: customer group ID.


<span id="bc1f7c49"></span>
# Use restrictions

Guest experiments only support private deployment of programming experiments \- server side experiments.


* Starting with privatization 4.9.0 version, if you also purchased CDP, you can also configure user audience rules using **customer base comparison**.

* Since the privatization 4.9.2 version, the customer group experiment supports the user grouping of DataFinder, and after the experiment is opened, the experimental results are displayed in the customer group dimension.


<span id="682c387b"></span>
# Preparation

<span id="8bf686dd"></span>
## (Optional) Data access

Before creating the experiment, you need to complete the required indicator tracking event access according to the experiment design. For detailed activity details of data access, please refer to: [Data Access Overview](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Data-Access-Overview).

<span id="4224a662"></span>
## Create user groups

You need to create a user group first. The current different versions support inconsistent user grouping capabilities.


* Starting from the privatization 4.9.0 version, you can select the user subgroups that have been created on the CDP. You need to create a user subgroup in the CDP first according to the experimental needs.

* Since the privatization 4.9.2 version, the customer group experiment supports the user grouping of DataFinder, and after the experiment is opened, the experimental results are displayed in the customer group dimension. You need to create a user cluster in DataFinder according to the needs of the experiment.


<span id="0e0bc32c"></span>
# Create a customer group experiment

Click " **+ Create Experiment**" on the experiment list page, select Programming Experiment, and enter the experiment creation process. The configuration points of the customer group experiment are as follows. Other configuration operations are consistent with the configuration of ordinary programming experiments. Please refer to the [Programming Experiment](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Programming-Experiment)documentation for details.


1. Configure basic information. The type of experiment for the customer group experiment needs to be selected on the server side.

2. Configure the effective policy. Among them, the **audience rules** can choose **customer group comparison**, add customer group and select the created user group.

   <span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5b8537cc78574bd296bfd64dfab11c9a~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

3. The configuration experiment version and the experimental index operation are consistent with the ordinary programming experiment. You can refer to the programming experiment operation document to complete the experiment creation.


<span id="d5104563"></span>
# Debug and start the experiment

After the experiment is created, it can be debugged, and the experiment can be started after there is no problem.

<span id="e592a758"></span>
# View the experimental report

If you have completed the quasi\-work of data access, after the experiment starts and the offline promotion starts, the user data generated by each promotion channel will be reported to DataTester one after another, and you can view the indicator results of the experimental version through the experimental report.


|Experiment details page |Lab report page |Data Metrics/Advanced Analytics Page |
|---|---|---|
|<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/5ad039561a224c8c946831ad376fa51f~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span><br><br><br>* You can view the customer group configuration details of the customer group experiment on the **experiment details** page.<br><br>* As depicted in the figure above, the customer group experiment consists of two customer groups: test and test 1. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/a044eea25cf04974a6ae436a113debfc~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span><br><br><br>* In the experimental report page, in addition to the experimental conclusions based on the experimental version, the experimental results are also given synchronously in combination with the experimental version + customer group.<br><br>* In the Data Overview section, you are shown the probability of winning for each customer group in each experimental version; and the probability of winning for each experimental version in each customer group.<br><br>* At the same time, a more professional variance analysis table is also provided to facilitate in\-depth data analytics. |<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/65f9631af9c04516ad41859a0b24eca8~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span><br><br><br>* You can view the metrics data under each customer group for each experimental version in the Data Metrics/Advanced Analytics page.<br><br>* The caliber and interpretation of the index data are similar to those of ordinary A/B experiments. For details, please refer to the report interpretation document of ordinary A/B experiments. |


For more customer group experiment special indicators and report interpretation, please see [Report Interpretation: Customer Group Experiment](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Report-Interpretation-Customer-Group-Experiment).
